### ChatGPT for Mac: Research Notes

#### **Overview & Requirements**
*   **Current App:** The official ChatGPT desktop app for macOS (rebuilt on July 9, 2026) integrates Chat, Work, and Codex into a single interface. The previous native client is now referred to as "ChatGPT Classic".
*   **System Requirements:** macOS 14 or newer, running on either Apple Silicon (M1 or better) or an Intel processor.
*   **Installation:** Official downloads are available only via `https://chatgpt.com/download/`.

#### **Common User Struggles**
According to official help center documentation and common troubleshooting queries, users most frequently struggle with:
*   **Connectivity & Access:** "Something went wrong" errors, often caused by VPNs, proxy connections, browser extensions (if using the web version), or temporary server-side outages.
*   **App Layout Changes:** Since the July 9, 2026, rebuild, many users report difficulty finding conversation history and Projects, which were moved within the new unified interface.
*   **Performance Issues:** Reports of the app being "too slow," lagging, or becoming unresponsive, often resolved by clearing the app cache, restarting the application, or starting a new chat for long conversations.
*   **Integration Permissions:** Users often encounter issues with the "Work with Apps" feature, which requires explicit macOS Accessibility permissions to read content from other applications.

#### **Keyboard Shortcuts**
*   **Global Chat Bar:** The default shortcut to open the ChatGPT companion window (Chat Bar) from any app is **Option + Space**.
*   **In-App Shortcuts:** Press **Cmd + /** while the app is active to view the full, customizable list of shortcuts.
*   **Customization:** Users can modify these shortcuts by navigating to **Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts** within the app.

#### **Key Statistics**
*   **User Growth:** ChatGPT reached **900 million weekly active users** as of February 2026.
*   **Enterprise Adoption:** **92% of Fortune 500 companies** use ChatGPT, with over 7 million active enterprise workplace seats.
*   **Subscriber Base:** As of April 2026, there were **50 million paying subscribers** across all tiers (Plus, Team, Pro, Enterprise).
*   **Usage Limits:** Limits vary by plan; for example, Plus and Standard Business seats share an estimated allowance (e.g., 15 to 160 messages per five-hour window for certain models), while Pro plans have removed the five-hour limit in favor of larger, tiered allowances.
